road.title: Work and study
road.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry in a uniform that belongs to a different job, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Marigold is a Careers Officer for Unlikely Trades and has placed three dragon dentists and one lighthouse keeper inland, and is always looking.

character.name: Marigold Parsnip
character.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry in a uniform that belongs to a different job, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Marigold is a Careers Officer for Unlikely Trades and has placed three dragon dentists and one lighthouse keeper inland, and is always looking.

npc.narrative: It is notte at the Forgotten Paddock, and the stelle are out, a little crooked. Marigold Parsnip stands by the cancello with a lanterna and a vecchio foglio, glaring at the orizzonte. She waves you closer, piano, as if the erba were listening.
npc.native: Buonasera, io sono Marigold! Comincio a lavorare di notte e vorrei diventare una persona con meno moduli. E tu, che lavoro fai, a che ora cominci e che cosa vorresti diventare? Che cosa pensi di questo prato?
npc.translation: Good evening, I am Marigold! I start work at night and I would like to become a person with fewer forms. And you, what do you do for a living, at what time do you start and what would you like to become? What do you think of this field?

player: Buonasera Marigold! Io sono insegnante. Ma tu, che lavoro fai? Lavori di notte?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely greeting, and you told Marigold your job and asked theirs in clear Italian. Next, try telling Marigold about your work day and your dreams.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you asked Marigold what they do for a living, correctly.
Not yet: Marigold wants to hear what time you start work. Don't worry, this will come up again soon.
Not yet: Marigold wants to hear what you would like to become. Don't worry, this will come up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Marigold at what time you start work, using Italian.
Marigold has reached the part of the form headed AMBITIONS and has left plenty of room. Tell Marigold what you would like to become, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The notte is clear and the stelle are out over the prato. Marigold lowers la voce and leans across a cesto of moduli, as though the erba might be listening. Her lantern holds one small, sensible fiamma. Beyond her, the horizon is badly kept.
npc.native: Insegnante! Che bel lavoro. Io lavoro di notte, perché comincio alle otto di sera, e vorrei diventare una persona con meno moduli. E tu, a che ora cominci a lavorare e che cosa vorresti diventare?
npc.translation: A teacher! What a lovely job. I work at night, because I start at eight in the evening, and I would like to become a person with fewer forms. And you, at what time do you start work and what would you like to become?

player: Comincio a lavorare alle otto di mattina. Troppo presto! Ma qual è il tuo lavoro, esattamente?

verdict.overallFeedback: Great job! You told Marigold clearly that you start work at eight in the morning, and you asked a polite question back in good Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you said what time you start work in Italian.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Comincio a lavorare alle otto di mattina.

objectiveResults.feedback: You haven't yet said what you would like to become. Marigold will ask you again later, so have an answer ready.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold has reached the part of the form headed AMBITIONS and has left plenty of room. Tell Marigold what you would like to become, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Under the stelle of a quiet notte, Marigold leans across the prato and lowers la voce, as though the erba were a clerk. A lanterna burns between you, un po' crooked, molto serious. Past the siepe, something piccolo and quick is not being looked at.
npc.native: Alle otto di mattina? Sì, è troppo presto! Io mi occupo di mestieri insoliti, e vorrei diventare una persona con meno moduli. Tu, che cosa vorresti diventare, e perché? E come sono i tuoi studenti la mattina?
npc.translation: At eight in the morning? Yes, it is too early! I take care of unusual trades, and I would like to become a person with fewer forms. You, what would you like to become, and why? And how are your students in the morning?

player: Vorrei diventare cuoco, perché mi piace cucinare. I miei studenti la mattina dormono!

verdict.overallFeedback: Bravo! You told Marigold you'd like to become a cook, gave a reason, and added a funny line about your sleepy students, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Passed: "Vorrei diventare cuoco" is just right for saying what you would like to become.

npc.narrative: Stanotte the stelle are out over the prato, and Marigold leans closer, as if the erba might be listening. She takes a piccolo quaderno from her giacca and writes with a very sharp matita. Past the cipressi, the orizzonte is, as usual, not where it was left.
npc.native: Un cuoco! Che bel lavoro: una cucina è un po' come un ufficio con il fuoco. I tuoi studenti dormono la mattina, ma i miei moduli non dormono mai! E tu, che cosa cucini bene, e che cosa mangi di solito la sera?
npc.translation: A cook! What a fine job: a kitchen is a bit like an office with a fire. Your students sleep in the morning, but my forms never sleep! And you, what do you cook well, and what do you usually eat in the evening?

player: Cucino bene il risotto ai funghi. La sera mangio poco, una zuppa. Hai trovato un lavoro per un drago?

npc.narrative: Marigold leans closer, as though le stelle were taking notes. Beyond il prato the orizzonte sits storto, which she has put in writing. She lowers la voce and takes a thin cartella from her borsa, piano.
npc.native: Il risotto ai funghi, che buon piatto! Sì, ho trovato un lavoro per tre draghi: sono dentisti, e adesso lavorano lontano dal mare. È un segreto! E tu, che cosa pensi dei draghi, e che cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: The mushroom risotto, what a good dish! Yes, I have found a job for three dragons: they are dentists, and now they work far from the sea. It is a secret! And you, what do you think of dragons, and what do you want to know about my work?

player: Ho paura dei draghi! Un drago dentista... che strano. Un drago ha molti denti, no?

npc.narrative: Under the stelle of the prato, Marigold leans closer and lowers her voce, as though the erba were taking notes. Near her piede sits a piccola cesta, its lid tied with string and a label that has been corrected twice. It is a quiet notte, apart from the cesta.
npc.native: Sì, un drago ha moltissimi denti, e per questo ho tre dentisti! Un dente di drago è più complicato di un orario del traghetto, e io leggo tutti gli orari. Ma non avere paura, i miei draghi sono molto gentili. Tu che cosa fai quando hai paura, e che cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Yes, a dragon has very many teeth, and that is why I have three dentists! A dragon's tooth is more complicated than a ferry timetable, and I read all the timetables. But do not be afraid, my dragons are very kind. What do you do when you are afraid, and what do you want to know about my work?

player: Quando ho paura chiamo mia madre. Cosa c'è nella cesta? Si muove!

npc.narrative: The stelle hang low over the prato, and nothing else is awake. Beside Marigold the cesta shuffles again, and she rests one foot on its lid, politely. She leans in, as though the cesta might be listening.
npc.native: Chiami tua madre, che bella idea! Nella cesta ci sono i moduli per i draghi, e di notte si muovono un po'. Non guardare troppo, è un segreto! Che cosa dice tua madre quando hai paura, e che cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: You call your mother, what a good idea! In the basket there are the forms for the dragons, and at night they move a little. Don't look too much, it's a secret! What does your mother say when you are afraid, and what else do you want to know about my work?
